shares.limitation: Cover-date shares are not verified October19 outstanding shares. Anti-dilutive instruments are nominal counts, not treasury-stock dilution; future scenario shares are explicit hypotheses.

actual_financials.capital_warning: Cash/investments back insurance obligations and statutory capital. No surplus-cash addback in equity P/S valuation; MD&A695.2 conflicts with balance-sheet777.7, unreconciled. Held surplus and required surplus are different, not a dividend headroom calculation.

management_guidance_July29.warning: Guidance and non-GAAP milestones, not actual Q3/Q4 or GAAP profitability. No new full-quarter financial filing through the research cutoff.

method: Equity price-to-revenue at 2028-12-31; discount future per-share equity values to valuation date. Do not add all cash/investments or subtract financing a second time. P/B, P/IFP, future margin/P-E and statutory-capital intensity are cross-checks, not separate additive values.

bear.interpretation: Slower growth, weak underwriting/capital economics and limited multiple support. Not an insolvency floor; a dilutive rescue can be substantially worse.

base.interpretation: Growth remains strong while normalized losses, financing costs and operating leverage permit real earnings. Revenue target and multiples are researcher assumptions, not consensus; at modest margins these are demanding P/E multiples.

bull.interpretation: Pet/Car quality and capital-efficient growth substantially outperform, with durable economic margins. FSD availability alone cannot support this scenario.

SBC_treatment: Future90M/94M shares explicitly allow net vesting, options and future grants in a broad scenario, not a strict fully-diluted count. Mature margin cross-check is after recurring SBC/financing/tax, and no extra same-award SBC cash deduction is applied. Existing nominal12.111M excluded awards cannot simply be added to actual shares and called treasury-stock dilution. Sensitivities at95M/100M test whether the assumed net dilution allowance is too optimistic.
capital_stress: Illustrative only: apply current required regulatory surplus/IFP intensity330/1434.3 to hypothetical future IFP. Not a legal RBC forecast; product mix, reinsurance, captives and regulation can materially change it. Do not add this capital need to valuation or subtract it again without a full capital plan.

previous_baseline.hypothesis_bridge: No new complete-quarter results justify changing 2028 revenue/multiple hypotheses merely because price declined. Update quote, newer August3 cover shares and time discount; new CFO-related8-K/A metadata and product availability do not receive separate platform value. The amendment body is unavailable and compensation search snippets are not accepted as verified issued shares.

gaps: Public current GAAP NTM EPS not independently verified; loss-making forward P/E not meaningful
